# Soma grammar

The single source of Soma's grammar. `tools/gen_grammar.py` turns it into `spec/soma.gbnf` (constrained decoding), `spec/grammar.md` (this text) and `editors/tree-sitter-soma/grammar.js`.

The notation is GBNF: `rule ::= a b | c`, "literal", [class], ( ), * + ?. A rule marked `# @lexical` is a token: it takes the longest text it can.

What the grammar promises: every program `soma` parses is in it (the test corpus is every `.cell` file of the repository). It is exact for what an agent writes — cells, the face, memory, state machines, handlers, statements, expressions — and deliberately loose in three places, where it takes any balanced block: the `rules`, `runtime`, `scale` and `cost` sections, a transition's `{ guard … effect … }` block, and `protocol`. It does not know the checks: a text in the grammar may still fail `soma check`.

## Program

```gbnf
root ::= ws ( top ws )*
top ::= cell | skeleton | flesh | use-decl | protocol
use-decl ::= "use" [ \t] [^\n]*    # token
protocol ::= "protocol" ws1 name ws braces
```

## Cells

```gbnf
cell ::= "cell" ws1 ( cell-kind ws1 )? name ws type-params? ws brackets? ws "{" ws ( section ws )* "}"
cell-kind ::= "agent" | "test" | "type" | "property" | "checker" | "backend" | "builtin"
type-params ::= "<" ws name ( ws "," ws name )* ws ">"
section ::= face | memory | state | handler | every | after | const | interior | variants | loose-section | test-rule
const ::= "const" ws1 name ws "=" ws unary
interior ::= "interior" ws "{" ws ( ( cell | skeleton ) ws )* "}"
```

## Skeleton and flesh

A skeleton is a cell without handler bodies: each signal of its face carries a frame. A flesh holds the bodies, and only them.

```gbnf
skeleton ::= "skeleton" ws1 ( "agent" ws1 )? name ws brackets? ws "{" ws ( skeleton-section ws )* "}"
skeleton-section ::= face | memory | state | every | after | const | interior | loose-section
flesh ::= "flesh" ws1 name ws "{" ws ( handler ws )* "}"
loose-section ::= ( "rules" | "runtime" | "scale" | "cost" ) ws braces
```

## Face

```gbnf
face ::= "face" ws "{" ws ( face-decl ws )* "}"
face-decl ::= signal-decl | tool-decl | await-decl | given-decl | promise-decl
signal-decl ::= "signal" ws1 name ws "(" params ")" ( ws "->" ws type )? ( ws ( contract | frame-clause ) )*
contract ::= ( "requires" | "ensures" ) ws1 expr
tool-decl ::= "tool" ws1 name ws "(" params ")" ( ws "->" ws type )? ( ws brackets )? ( ws string )? ( ws frame-clause )*
```

The frame: what the handler may read, write, call, emit, and which edges it may take.

```gbnf
frame-clause ::= frame-names | frame-moves
frame-names ::= ( "reads" | "writes" | "calls" | "emits" ) ws1 frame-path ( ws "," ws frame-path )*
frame-moves ::= "moves" ws1 ( frame-path ws ":" ws )? frame-edge ( ws "," ws frame-edge )*
frame-path ::= name ( "." name )?
frame-edge ::= ( name | "*" ) ws "->" ws ( name | "*" )
await-decl ::= "await" ws1 name ws "(" params ")" ( ws "->" ws type )?
given-decl ::= "given" ws1 name ws ":" ws type ( ws "where" ws braces )?
promise-decl ::= "promise" [ \t] [^\n]*    # token
params ::= ws ( param ( ws "," ws param )* ( ws "," )? )? ws
param ::= name ( ws ":" ws type )?
type ::= name ( "." name )? ( ws "<" ws type ( ws "," ws type )* ws ">" )? "?"?
```

## Memory

```gbnf
memory ::= "memory" ws "{" ws ( memory-item ws )* "}"
memory-item ::= invariant | slot
slot ::= name ws ":" ws type ( ws brackets )? ( ws "=" ws expr )?
invariant ::= "invariant" ws1 expr
```

## State machines

```gbnf
state ::= "state" ws1 name ( ws ":" ws name )? ( ws brackets )? ws "{" ws ( state-item ws )* "}"
state-item ::= initial | transition
initial ::= "initial" ws ":" ws name
transition ::= ( name | "*" ) ( ws "->" ws name )+ ( ws "except" ws brackets )? ( ws braces )?
```

## Handlers and timers

```gbnf
handler ::= "on" ws1 name ws "(" params ")" ( ws "->" ws type )? ( ws brackets )? ws block
every ::= "every" ws1 number ( ws brackets )? ws block
after ::= "after" ws1 number ( ws brackets )? ws block
```

## Variants

```gbnf
variants ::= "variants" ws "{" ws ( variant ws ","? ws )* "}"
variant ::= name ( ws "(" ws type ( ws "," ws type )* ws ")" | ws "{" params "}" )?
```

## Tests

The rules of a `cell test`, in its `rules { }` block or directly in the cell.

```gbnf
test-rule ::= assert | assert-fails | mock | property | let
assert ::= "assert" ws1 expr
assert-fails ::= "assert_fails" ws1 expr ( ws "matching" ws string )?
mock ::= "mock" ws1 name ( "." name )? ( hws "error" hws string | hws expr )?
property ::= "property" ws1 string ws "forall" ws1 name ws ":" ws type ws1 "in" ws1 expr ( ws ".." ws expr )? ( ws1 "count" ws1 number )? ws1 "ensures" ws1 expr
```

## Statements

```gbnf
block ::= "{" ws ( stmt ws )* "}"
stmt ::= let | return | if | for | while | emit | require | ensure | assign | ";" | expr
let ::= "let" ws1 name ( ws ":" ws type )? ws "=" ws expr
return ::= "return" ( ws expr )?
if ::= "if" ws1 expr ws block ( ws "else" ws ( if | block ) )?
for ::= "for" ws ( brackets ws )? name ( ws "," ws name )? ( ws brackets )? ws1 "in" ws1 expr ws block
while ::= "while" ws1 expr ws block
emit ::= ( "emit" | "signal" ) ws1 name ws "(" args ")"
require ::= "require" ws1 expr ws "else" ws1 ( string | name ( hws string )? )
ensure ::= "ensure" ws1 expr
assign ::= name ( ws "." ws name | hws "[" ws expr ws "]" )* ws assign-op ws expr
assign-op ::= "=" | "+=" | "-=" | "*=" | "/="
```

## Expressions

Loosest first: `|>`, `||`, `&&`, `??`, comparisons, `+ - ++`, `* / %`, unary `! -`, then calls, fields and indexes.

```gbnf
expr ::= or ( ws "|>" ws or )*
or ::= and ( ws "||" ws and )*
and ::= coalesce ( ws "&&" ws coalesce )*
coalesce ::= comparison ( ws "??" ws comparison )*
comparison ::= additive ( ws compare-op ws additive )*
compare-op ::= "==" | "!=" | "<=" | ">=" | "<" | ">"
additive ::= multiplicative ( ws ( "++" | "+" | "-" ) ws multiplicative )*
multiplicative ::= unary ( ws ( "*" | "/" | "%" ) ws unary )*
unary ::= ( "!" | "-" ) ws unary | postfix
postfix ::= primary ( ws "." ws name ( "(" args ")" )? | hws "[" ws expr ws "]" | hws "(" args ")" | "?" )*
primary ::= lambda | if | match | try | await | record | list | paren | string | number | name
lambda ::= ( name | "(" ws ( name ( ws "," ws name )* )? ws ")" ) ws "=>" ws ( block | expr )
match ::= "match" ws1 expr ws "{" ws ( arm ws ","? ws )* "}"
arm ::= pattern ( ws "|" ws pattern )* ( ws "if" ws1 expr )? ws ( "->" | "=>" ) ws ( block | stmt )
pattern ::= name ws braces | braces | expr ( ws ".." ws expr )?
try ::= "try" ws ( block | expr ) ( ws "catch" ( ws name )? ws block )?
await ::= "await" ws1 name ws "(" args ")"
record ::= name ws "{" ws ( field ( ws ","? ws field )* )? ws ","? ws "}"
field ::= name ws ":" ws expr
list ::= "[" ws ( expr ( ws "," ws expr )* ( ws "," )? )? ws "]"
paren ::= "(" ws expr? ws ")"
args ::= ws ( expr ( ws "," ws expr )* ( ws "," )? )? ws
```

## Tokens

```gbnf
name ::= [a-zA-Z_] [a-zA-Z0-9_]*    # token
```

A number, with the suffix that makes it a duration (`30s`, `2h`) or a percentage (`5%`).

```gbnf
number ::= ( "0" [xXbBoO] [0-9a-fA-F_]+ | [0-9] [0-9_]* ( "." [0-9] [0-9_]* )? ( [eE] [+-]? [0-9]+ )? ) ( "ms" | "s" | "min" | "h" | "d" | "years" | "%" )?    # token
string ::= "\"\"\"" ( [^"] | "\"" [^"] | "\"\"" [^"] )* "\"\"\"" | "\"" ( [^"\\] | "\\" [^\x00] )* "\""    # token
comment ::= "//" [^\n]* | "/*" ( [^*] | "*"+ [^*/] )* "*"+ "/"    # token
```

Whitespace and comments, between any two tokens.

```gbnf
ws ::= ( [ \t\n\r] | comment )*    # token
ws1 ::= ( [ \t\n\r] | comment )+    # token
hws ::= [ \t]*    # token
```

## Balanced blocks

Any text whose braces, brackets and parentheses match.

```gbnf
braces ::= "{" loose* "}"
brackets ::= "[" loose* "]"
parens ::= "(" loose* ")"
loose ::= braces | brackets | parens | string | comment | filler
filler ::= [^{}()\[\]"/]+ | "/"    # token
```
